description: Daily side-by-side version comparison of Tekton Results ingestion, API performance, and component resource usage. Test ID 425.

panels.description: Rate at which the Results watcher ingests completed PipelineRuns (records/sec). Higher indicates faster ingestion. Compare across versions to detect watcher performance regressions.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('day', start), 'MM/DD') AS day,
    DATE_TRUNC('day', start) AS day_date,
    CASE WHEN label_values ? '__deployment_nightly' AND (label_values->>'__deployment_nightly')::BOOLEAN = true THEN 'nightly' ELSE COALESCE(label_values->>'__deployment_version', 'unknown') END AS version,
    (label_values->>'__results_PipelineRuns_ingestion_throughput')::DOUBLE PRECISION AS val
  FROM data
  WHERE horreum_testid = 425
    AND $__timeFilter(start)
    AND CASE WHEN label_values ? '__deployment_nightly' AND (label_values->>'__deployment_nightly')::BOOLEAN = true THEN 'nightly' ELSE COALESCE(label_values->>'__deployment_version', 'unknown') END IN ($version)
    AND label_values ? '__results_PipelineRuns_ingestion_throughput'
)
SELECT day, version, AVG(val) AS value
FROM daily
GROUP BY day, version
ORDER BY MIN(day_date),
  CASE WHEN version = 'nightly' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  version ASC

    CASE WHEN label_values ? '__deployment_nightly' AND (label_values->>'__deployment_nightly')::BOOLEAN = true THEN 'nightly' ELSE COALESCE(label_values->>'__deployment_version', 'unknown') END AS version,
    (label_values->>'__measurements_etcdRequestDurationSecondsAverage_mean')::DOUBLE PRECISION AS val
  FROM data
  WHERE horreum_testid = 425
    AND $__timeFilter(start)
    AND CASE WHEN label_values ? '__deployment_nightly' AND (label_values->>'__deployment_nightly')::BOOLEAN = true THEN 'nightly' ELSE COALESCE(label_values->>'__deployment_version', 'unknown') END IN ($version)
    AND label_values ? '__measurements_etcdRequestDurationSecondsAverage_mean'
)
SELECT day, version, AVG(val) AS value
FROM daily
GROUP BY day, version
ORDER BY MIN(day_date),
  CASE WHEN version = 'nightly' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  version ASC
